producer_report.summary: I added a design note, docs/design/per-job-landing-branches.md, for throughput review 20261108-183648-5eya. It proposes one job, one commit and one pull request cut from current main, in place of the stacked long-lived landing branch. I also added short pointers to it in continuous-landing.md and squash-chain-landing.md. This pass I reverted my CHANGELOG.md entry so the diff stays under docs/design/. I ran only `git diff --stat` and the policy test (17 passed). I did not re-read the new note in this pass. My evidence for its content criteria is from the earlier pass.
